supported_claims: On the current 32-wave dependent cold-load trace, useful modeled miss-level parallelism saturates at 32 MSHRs; larger MSHR counts do not improve runtime because the trace exposes no more than 32 independent blocking misses at once.
Outstanding-line coalescing reduces modeled DRAM transactions from 128 to 8 without reducing the 1219-cycle latency-bound runtime once enough MSHRs are available.
True post-fill L1 reuse is behaviorally distinct from coalescing and reduces modeled runtime from 1219 to 360 cycles on the matched trace.
claim_boundary: Synthetic timing-model evidence only. Cache geometry and timing are provisional architecture parameters. No physical area, power, frequency, GDDR7 behavior, NoC behavior, real-workload performance, commercial-GPU superiority, or RTX 5090 equivalence is established.
